sources.title: LFM2-8B-A1B: An Efficient On-device Mixture-of-Experts — Blog
sources.snippet: We are releasing LFM2-8B-A1B, our first on-device Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with 8.3B total parameters and 1.5B active parameters per token. By activating only a sparse subset of parameters during inference, LFM2-8B-A1B delivers larger model quality with the compute of a 1.5B-class model.
